subject: POC Risk Tracker / Stellar Commerce - success criteria & mitigation plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lewis <jared@stellar-commerce.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & proposed POC plan / Stellar Commerce

Thanks for taking the time today, Jared — good conversation. Per our call, I wanted to capture the proposed POC scope, success criteria, and next steps so we have a single source of truth. Attached: poc-success-criteria.docx and a mutual-action-plan.xlsx with owners/timelines.

High-level POC plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0: Kickoff + credentials & test data access
- Week 1: Integration + baseline latency/cost benchmarking
- Week 2: Feature validation (chat flows + reranking)
- Week 3: Acceptance testing + handover

Proposed success criteria (draft):
1) Average 95th-percentile latency < 350ms for the primary chat route under test load (as measured by Redwood console)
2) Model responses meet the QA pass rate of >= 90% on the provided eval prompt-set (see doc)
3) End-to-end cost <= $0.006 per interaction (target)

Ownership:
- Redwood: integration help, model selection, dev support (Dev Patel)
- Stellar: provide test dataset, security contacts, and evaluation rubric (Jared + Amira)

Open items / blockers:
- Need SOC2 evidence and data retention policy (Amira to confirm)
- Test data access + S3 credentials (Jared)

Next steps:
1) Jared — share S3 read-only test bucket + evaluation rubric (by Mon 2/23)
2) Marissa — send updated mutual action plan and invite for kickoff (by Mon 2/23)

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Adding some technical detail / risks from the Redwood side so we can agree mitigations up front. I pulled a quick checklist (attached: poc-tech-checklist.pdf) and opened an internal sup ticket SUP-1127 for the KV cache behavior we saw in an earlier POC.

Top risks (and mitigations):
1) KV cache cold-start can cause higher latency for longer context windows
   - Mitigation: warm cache with representative prompt prefixes during Week 0 (owner: Redwood infra, Markus Klein)
   - JIRA: SUP-1127
2) Data access permissions — limited S3 creds may block evaluation jobs
   - Mitigation: request a read-only bucket and one sample export; if not possible, we can accept a sanitized CSV via secure upload (owner: Stellar)
3) Model mismatch for reranking step — open fallback if top model underperforms
   - Mitigation: run parallel baseline on a lightweight quantized model and compare (owner: Dev Patel)
4) Cost overrun if eval prompts trigger long generations
   - Mitigation: add token caps for POC and track in Redwood Console cost dashboard (owner: Monica Patel)

If any of these are blocking for Stellar, flag them now so we can escalate. Proposed owners are in parentheses; happy to update.

Thanks — Dev

--
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Team — quick update after reviewing Dev's checklist. I created a short risk tracker in Drive (link below) and updated the mutual-action-plan.xlsx with explicit owners and due dates. Summary:

Current open risks: 
- SUP-1127 (KV cache warm): blocker for Week 1 benchmarking if not addressed — owner Markus Klein (Redwood infra) — mitigation: warm-run before baseline; ETA 48 hours after kickoff.
- S3 credentials pending: blocker for any evaluation jobs — owner Jared — mitigation: share read-only bucket or sanitized export by Mon 2/23.
- Acceptance rubric examples (hallucination checks): pending from Stellar — owner Jared/Amira — needed by Tue 2/24 to proceed with model tuning.

Escalation path if a risk becomes blocking:
1) Owner escalates to Marissa (sales) and Dev (engineering)
2) If unresolved after 24 hours, escalate to Markus Klein (infra lead) and Monica Patel (ops lead)
3) If production-impacting or SLA-risk, we will open an executive escalation with Aditya Rao (head of sales operations) and the Stellar exec sponsor.

Action items (updated):
- Jared: Share S3 access or sanitized export (by Mon 2/23) — pending
- Markus: KV cache warm-run plan and ETA (by Fri 2/27) — in progress
- Monica: Configure cost limits and dashboard alerts in Redwood Console (by Wed 2/25) — in progress
